fields.description: Privacy: by default the badge scanner works without showing the camera image, so employees never feel filmed. Enable this to show a live preview on the kiosk instead.
fields.label: Show Camera Preview on Kiosk

fields.description: Play a short confirmation sound on the kiosk after a successful punch (rising tone for IN, falling tone for OUT).
fields.label: Play Sounds on Kiosk

fields.description: Language of the kiosk UI (labels, dates, confirmation screen). Backend error messages follow the kiosk user's language.
fields.label: Kiosk Language

fields.description: Kiosk terminals opening /kiosk?token=... are logged in as this user automatically. Must be a dedicated user with only the Timeclock Kiosk role.
fields.label: Kiosk Auto-Login User

fields.description: Shared secret for the kiosk start URL (min. 20 characters). Changing it locks out all devices immediately until their URL is updated.
fields.label: Kiosk Auto-Login Token

fields.description: When the server cannot be reached, the kiosk keeps accepting punches and stores them on the device. They are booked as soon as the connection is back. PIN and badge are checked by the server at that moment, never on the device.
fields.label: Allow Punching While Offline

fields.description: Offline punches older than this when they reach the server are not booked automatically but held for review.
fields.label: Max. Age of Offline Punches (Hours)

fields.description: Send an alert when a kiosk has not reported for this many minutes. 0 disables alerts. A kiosk shows as Offline after two minutes without contact regardless of this value.
fields.label: Alert After Silence (Minutes)

fields.description: One email address per line. Receives offline alerts, recovery notices and offline punches that hit an already marked attendance.
fields.label: Alert Recipients
